plate_comment: Processes a TSC1 (PGN 0) for the engine (from cm848_dispatchTsc1ByDestinationAddress). Byte 1 bits 1-2 are the override control mode (SPN 695), bits 3-4 the requested speed control conditions (SPN 696) and bits 5-6 the override control mode priority (SPN 897); bytes 2-3 are the requested speed (SPN 898) and byte 4 the requested torque (SPN 518). It rejects a sender that is in the ignored request list or has no tsc1_source_configuration_table entry. A sender takes over an active request only with an entry at the same or an earlier position and an equal or higher priority (in mode 3 at the same priority: a lower torque or speed). On accept: mode 1 = speed control (the requested speed capped at 24000 = 3000 rpm), mode 2 = torque control (the requested percent torque as fueling), mode 3 = speed / torque limit control; each loads its request timeout from the sender's entry. CM550's 0x2f128 is the same handler (was torqueControlModeHandler)
